verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's Session Replay feature is explicitly marketed as a way to explore 'why' customers drop off in funnels, and replay playlists can be built from events/properties, supporting a PM's drop-off-to-replay workflow. However, evidence doesn't confirm a direct one-click jump from a specific funnel drop-off or error event to matching replays, nor is error-event-triggered replay linking documented.
